lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Numerous high-luminance circular pixel clusters arranged in a semi-regular grid posterior to the gill region; mid-flank blobs exhibit larger diameters and greater inter-centroid spacing compared to the dense, smaller clusters on the cephalic region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Visible vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal rows of blobs, creating a grid-like matrix where blobs function as primary anchor nodes, most distinct in the mid-lateral section.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A single prominent linear feature runs horizontally across the upper flank, exhibiting a distinct luminance gradient with high intensity on the dorsal edge and localized shadowing on the ventral edge.
